items.title: MemDerive: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agent Memory over Evolving Data
items.title_zh: MemDerive：面向演化数据的智能体记忆诊断基准
items.summary: MemDerive is a diagnostic benchmark for agent memory over evolving data with 10 scenarios, 4,692 events and 1,503 queries, deriving exact gold answers with Datalog and recording each gold derivation DAG and supporting events. Evaluating four memory systems, it found every system fell behind simple BM25 on derived state, most failures were ungathered intermediate states, and systems rarely propagated implicit changes.

items.title: Verifier-Grounded Agentic RL for Provably Correct Code
items.title_zh: 基于验证器的 Agentic RL：训练可证明正确的代码
items.summary: The authors build an agentic reinforcement-learning environment that rewards code candidates by the weighted share of proof obligations they discharge from verifier diagnostics, adding an integrity audit against specification tampering. Across Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 14B and a 35B Qwen3.6 mixture-of-experts model, held-out verification reportedly rises from 66.1% to 93.5% on DafnyBench and from 56.3% to 100% on SWE-Proof.

items.title: Graph Serializations for Reasoning LLMs: A Study Across Knowledge Extraction and Structural Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向推理 LLM 的图序列化：跨知识抽取与结构推理的研究
items.summary: A study evaluates 15 knowledge-graph serialization formats across nine frontier LLM configurations on ontology-based knowledge extraction and structural graph reasoning tasks. It finds extraction is relatively insensitive to format while structural reasoning accuracy varies significantly, and proposes treating serialization as a dynamic orchestration decision.

items.title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: HybridResearcher：打通结构化与非结构化边界的深度研究智能体
items.summary: HybridResearcher is a 4B agent built from synthesized cross-source trajectories and trained with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning to reason across structured and unstructured sources. On HybridDeepResearch it improves 30.0 points pass@8 over its Qwen3.5-4B base and surpasses the larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points.

items.title: BrowseSafe++: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detection Across Web Contexts, Languages, and Browser Views
items.title_zh: BrowseSafe++：跨网页上下文、语言与浏览器视图的提示注入检测基准
items.summary: BrowseSafe++ expands BrowseSafe from 14,719 pages to 38,675 paired pages, mostly carrying prompt injections observed in the wild on production websites, with each attacked page paired with a clean control and provided as HTML, Markdown, an accessibility tree and a screenshot. Two 0.8B-parameter detectors trained on the pairs, BrowseSafe-Guard, beat a frontier-model-based detector on F1 while keeping false positives and inference cost low.

items.title_zh: BrowseSafe++：跨网页上下文、语言与浏览器视图的提示注入检测基准

items.title: Origin Attribution for Unsafe Behavior in Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Coding Systems
items.title_zh: 自演化多智能体编码系统中不安全行为的来源归因
items.summary: The paper studies origin attribution in self-evolving multi-agent coding systems, recovering the agent and program version that introduced an unsafe behavior into a target's code lineage, or determining that it arose locally. Its method combines behavioral fingerprint matching with historical localization and recursive tracing, achieving 96.8% exact attribution accuracy on 158 queries across 85 controlled scenarios versus 77.2% for non-recursive fingerprint matching.

items.title: Did the LLM Answer the Question? A Semantic Reconstruction Game for Jailbreak Evaluation
items.title_zh: LLM 真的回答了问题吗？用于越狱评估的语义重建游戏
items.summary: The paper reports that changing only the judge LLM can shift measured jailbreak attack success rate by up to 82 percentage points, and proposes a training-free semantic reconstruction game that reconstructs the request a response answers and compares it with decoy requests. Across three off-the-shelf judges it shows the lowest mean error against human labels among evaluated methods and reduces ASR variance.

items.title: TRACER: Trace-Regularized Training Against Indirect Prompt Injection
items.title_zh: TRACER：针对间接提示注入的轨迹正则化训练
items.summary: TRACER is a channel-aware adversarial training method that defends LLMs against indirect prompt injection arriving through retrieved content, tool outputs, and agent messages. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, it reduces RAG-framed attack success from 65.5% to 6.1% while preserving 78-82% clean accuracy.

items.title: INFUSE: A Unified Surface Benchmark for Indirect Prompt Injection in Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: INFUSE：智能体系统中间接提示注入的统一表面基准
items.summary: INFUSE is an end-to-end benchmark for indirect prompt injection across long-horizon agent workflows, with 40 realistic tasks and 56 attack scenarios injected through interaction surfaces encountered during execution. Evaluating 19 LLMs produced 41,824 adversarial trajectories, with mean attack success of 19.6% under LLM-based evaluation; prompt-level instructional hardening reduced mean attack success from 58.2% to 14.3%.

items.title: VELD-QA: A Large-Scale Dataset for Visual Evidence Grounding and Question Answering in Long Documents
items.title_zh: VELD-QA：面向长文档视觉证据定位与问答的大规模数据集
items.summary: VELD-QA is a benchmark of 15,000 human-authored question-answer pairs across 5,859 real-world PDFs totaling 372,445 pages, with page-level and visual-element evidence annotations that allow retrieval and interpretation to be scored separately. Evaluating nine vision-language models and seven retrieval-augmented or agentic systems found that even with ground-truth supporting pages, accuracy peaks at 81.7%, and enriching inputs with visual-element annotations narrows the performance gap by 17-24%.

items.title: NoveltyScope: A Multi-Agent Research Assistant for Evidence-Grounded Novelty Assessment of Scientific Papers
items.title_zh: NoveltyScope：面向科学论文证据驱动新颖性评估的多智能体研究助手
items.summary: NoveltyScope compares a paper with retrieved prior work using BM25 and dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion, then has Prosecutor, Defender, Judge and Critic roles produce an evidence-grounded five-level novelty score. On 50 balanced RINoBench samples, multi-agent scoring had lower mean absolute error than single-LLM scoring with both Gemini and Qwen3.

items.title: Continuous Ontology Assurance through External Resources -- An Ontology Engineering Method with a Case Study in Software Language Engineering
items.title_zh: 通过外部资源实现持续本体保证：面向软件语言工程的案例研究
items.summary: COATER is an ontology engineering method that manages executable review components called arrows to check ontology axioms against evolving external resources. In an FSL ontology case study, an LLM-assisted linkage exercise raised Wikipedia-link compliance from 405 to 600 of 600 entities.

items.title: Who Plans, Who Edits? Verified, Cost-Aware Division of Labor for LLM-Driven Analog Layout Repair
items.title_zh: 谁规划，谁编辑？LLM 驱动模拟版图修复中经验证、成本感知的分工
items.summary: A tool-grounded analog-layout repair agent has models choose bounded layout operators while sign-off tools recheck every edit, and 182 blind runs show cheap models execute plans but rarely succeed alone. A learning controller that assigns planner and editor roles fixed 7 of 8 episodes on four sealed held-out tasks, matching the OpenAI flagship alone at 15-40% of its spend per fix on three tasks, though with 8% higher spend overall.

items.title: An Impossibility Result for ETF Target Geometry, and an Equinorm Remedy for Imbalanced Analytic Continual Learning
items.title_zh: ETF 目标几何的不可能性结果，以及面向不平衡解析持续学习的等范数补救
items.summary: The paper shows that fusing analytic continual learning with progressively expanded Simplex ETF targets is identical to plain one-hot ACIL, and that the literal expansion introduces about four times the catastrophic forgetting of a classic ACIL head. Applying equinorm post-processing to the fitted classifier weights instead recovers tail and overall accuracy under long-tailed imbalance, including +32.0 tail and +16.0 average points at 100:1 on CIFAR-100/ViT.

items.title: Measuring Data Diversity with Embeddings: A Taxonomy and Benchmark for Diversity Measures
items.title_zh: 用嵌入衡量数据多样性：多样性度量的分类与基准
items.summary: The authors present a taxonomy of 21 embedding-based diversity measures grouped into four families and introduce EmbDivBench, which evaluates them on variety, balance and disparity using simulated and natural text. Mean Pairwise Distance, the most commonly used measure, was outperformed on those components, with Graph Entropy the best overall choice.

items.title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
items.title_zh: 钙钛矿光伏领域结构化检索增强生成基准
items.summary: The benchmark provides 755 quantitative answers computed from 45,441 measured perovskite photovoltaic device records and evaluates six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers. Standard passage retrieval reaches 16-23% accuracy, while read-only SQL execution over the structured device table raises accuracy to 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature.

items.title: Distilling Text LMs into Speech-to-Speech LMs by Matching Internal Text Predictions
items.title_zh: 通过匹配内部文本预测将文本语言模型蒸馏为语音到语音语言模型
items.summary: The paper introduces a speech-to-speech pretraining method that creates an internal text interface: the model consumes speech without its transcription, switches to text prediction, then uses the predicted text to guide speech generation word by word. Under matched training conditions this improves generative perplexity of spoken continuations, and distillation from a base text LM improves factual performance under both text and speech evaluation.

items.title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
items.title_zh: World-T3：将测试时训练作为实时视频世界模型的持久记忆
items.summary: World-T3 is a camera-controlled video world model that consolidates past observations into model parameters via test-time training, using a recursive least-squares rule for pose-keyed online memory updates. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark it raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and cuts absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280x704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.

items.title: Learning from Self-Generated Responses: Reliability--Uncertainty Self-Distillation for Reasoning
items.title_zh: 从自生成回答中学习：面向推理的可靠性—不确定性自蒸馏
items.summary: The paper proposes Reliability-Uncertainty Self-Distillation, in which one model serves as both teacher and student and weights each self-generated attempt by judged reliability and predictive uncertainty. Across eleven reasoning benchmarks it reports 70.47% average accuracy on Qwen3-4B and 76.69% on Qwen3-8B, outperforming five baselines.

items.title: Failure Is the Mother of Success: Recovering Supervision with Grounding Hindsight
items.title_zh: 失败乃成功之母：利用有依据的事后回放恢复监督信号
items.summary: Replay-Selected Hindsight Distillation turns failed GRPO rollouts into extra supervision: the policy writes a corrective note without seeing a reference answer, re-solves the problem with the note, and a note is admitted only if, after screening for answer-stating notes, its replays succeed more often than the original group. The method consistently improves over GRPO across model families and sizes and carries gains to out-of-domain benchmarks.

items.title: Prune the Summary, Not the History: Source-Judged Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 修剪摘要而非历史：面向长程智能体的来源判定压缩
items.summary: Source-Judged Compaction is a training-free post-processing step that scores each entry in a context-compaction summary for support in environment outputs or the previous summary and removes unsupported entries. In an analysis of a widely used structured compressor, 83% of failed runs traced to an action carrying out a specific summary entry, most of which no environment output supported; SJC improved cross-run reliability by 2.1%-8.9% on AppWorld and OfficeBench without increasing token usage.

items.title: HeRE: A Novel Benchmark for Hebrew Relation Extraction via LLM-Guided Denoising of Knowledge Graph Alignments
items.title_zh: HeRE：通过 LLM 引导的知识图谱对齐去噪构建希伯来语关系抽取基准
items.summary: The authors propose a language-agnostic pipeline that builds relation-extraction data by denoising noisy knowledge-base and text alignments, validated through natural language inference. Applying it produces HeRE, a 1.5-million-instance silver dataset for Hebrew, where the best open-weights model reaches F1 0.915 versus 0.921 for the best API model.

items.title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
items.title_zh: CME-SpectrumBench：LLM 能分析凝聚态光谱数据吗？
items.summary: CME-SpectrumBench is an expert-designed 190-question benchmark that tests whether frontier LLMs can analyze simulated condensed-matter spectral data, scored by how closely numerical answers approach ground truth. Under direct query models find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, while tool access to a Python interpreter brings performance close to handwritten code.

items.title: MOSS: A Production Framework for Monitoring and Diagnosing Semantic Failures in Search and Recommendation Systems
items.title_zh: MOSS：用于监控和诊断搜索与推荐系统语义故障的生产框架
items.summary: MOSS embeds LLM-based relevance scoring into a recurring production monitoring loop with targeted sampling, strategy-aware prompting, structured alerting, and diagnostic follow-up that categorizes failures into root causes. Running for over six months at a large U.S. retailer, it surfaced two confirmed serving defects, and its LLM judges achieved higher F1 and AUC point estimates than non-LLM baselines on a human-annotated recommendation benchmark, with the same judge transferring to a search benchmark after only a surface-specific prompt adaptation.

items.title: A Cross-Domain Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型提示技术的跨领域评估
items.summary: One LLM is compared across zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, RAG and a PE2-inspired automatic prompt-optimization pipeline on six benchmarks covering arithmetic, logical and commonsense reasoning plus factual verification. No strategy consistently won, pairwise differences among the best configurations were not significant, and RAG had the highest average accuracy at 78.33% with 300 retrieval examples.

items.title: LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向异构优化的基于 LLM 的评估规划
items.summary: REP-HO replaces the rule-based mixed-fidelity selection step in heterogeneous optimization with an LLM planner that receives surrogate predictions, uncertainties, evaluation costs and budget status. Across five regimes one of its variants achieved the best mean ranking score in every regime, REP-HO(DeepSeek) placed first or second throughout, and the planner adapted allocation such as prioritizing constraint evaluations under tighter budgets.

items.title: Atoms, Not Knowledge: What Production-Scale Addressed-Memory Writes Deposit
items.title_zh: 原子而非知识：生产级地址化记忆写入究竟沉淀了什么
items.summary: The paper reports a production-scale audit of deterministic hash-addressed conditional memory across 124M-7B beds, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, concluding that writes are independently retrievable, precisely addressable, reversible atoms rather than composable knowledge. Coverage fell from 98% at 50 facts to 12.7% at 1,000, two-hop composition did not exceed the single-hop baseline (26% observed vs 25% expected), and a 28-point in-context gap localized failure to retrieval-for-reasoning.

items.title: Learning Which Device to Call: Online Tool Grounding for LLM Agents in IoT
items.title_zh: 学会调用哪台设备：IoT 中 LLM Agent 的在线工具接地
items.summary: The paper studies online tool grounding for LLM agents in IoT, where one requested capability is offered by several devices and the agent's plan does not specify which to call. It formulates device selection as a contextual bandit problem and reports higher step success and better cost-adjusted service, at lower simulated energy and latency, than nearest-device, UCB1 and LinUCB baselines in a simulated loading-dock workload.

items.title: kitlangton/scrawl
items.title_zh: Scrawl：向智能体标注、录制并发送问题的 Rust 工具
items.summary: Scrawl is a Rust tool that lets a user show a problem to an agent by marking it up, recording it, and sending it.

items.title: Oct 15, 2026 Product Insights ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction Read
items.title_zh: ExtractBench Pro：文档抽取评估的长尾问题
items.summary: LlamaIndex published a product post introducing ExtractBench Pro, framing document extraction evaluation around the long tail of extraction cases.

items.title: xiaoyang111222/cn-math-taxonomy
items.title_zh: xiaoyang111222/cn-math-taxonomy：小初高学科知识图谱
items.summary: cn-math-taxonomy is a Chinese K-12 knowledge graph covering math, English and middle-school physics, with 1,644 knowledge points, 2,403 prerequisite edges and 6,723 questions aligned to curriculum standards, plus adaptive prerequisite diagnostics.

items.title: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
items.title_zh: 模拟学生学习以改进 AI 辅导
items.summary: Microsoft Research describes StudentSim, a system for evaluating and improving AI tutoring tools before they are tested with learners. It models how individuals may engage with tutors and feeds that back to improve tutor performance across subjects such as chess, writing and mathematics.

items.title: We turned EmbeddingGemma 2 into a speech-to-text model
items.title_zh: 我们把 EmbeddingGemma 2 改造成了语音转文字模型
items.summary: A project turns the EmbeddingGemma 2 embedding model into an on-device speech-to-text model that processes an hour of audio in about 13 seconds on a base MacBook Air.

items.title: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
items.title_zh: 欧盟 AI 的下一章是智能体化
items.summary: A new OpenAI analysis examines how agentic AI adoption is growing across EU enterprises and small businesses, and where deeper use could unlock more value.

items.title: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
items.title_zh: 用 Claude 设计更高效的量子电路
items.summary: Anthropic gave Claude plain-language specifications for eight quantum circuits along with an automated evaluator, and the model improved on the best published circuits, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more.

items.title: DeepSeek search and fetch – $0.75 per 1000 successful requests
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 搜索与抓取 API：每千次成功请求 0.75 美元
items.summary: DeepSeek documents a Search API and a Fetch API that give agents and RAG applications access to live web content, with the post title listing pricing at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests.

items.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
items.title_zh: 混合推理 Agent：在潜空间中思考、以文本行动
items.summary: A Hacker News submission points to work on hybrid reasoning agents that think in latent space and act through text, linking the arXiv paper, the togethercomputer/HybridAgent GitHub repository and a Hugging Face collection. Evaluation results are linked from the paper's HTML version.

items.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
items.title_zh: Amp 借助 OpenAI 模型让 AI 智能体超越代码
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Amp extends AI agents beyond coding with GPT-6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT-Live-1, and Sign in with ChatGPT.

items.title: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
items.title_zh: Sullivan & Cromwell 将法律专业知识引入协议审查
items.summary: Sullivan & Cromwell worked with OpenAI to develop Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool that identifies issues in a draft agreement.

items.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
items.title_zh: Stack Overflow for Agents 借助 ChatGPT 插件使注册量增长两倍
items.summary: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10x growth in agent creation.
